source: CEPII BACI V202601, based on UN Comtrade

260300.title: Copper ores and concentrates
260300.boundary: The mined concentrate; Chile/Peru/DRC lead, routed heavily to Chinese smelters.

740311.title: Refined copper cathodes
740311.boundary: The refined metal; Chile/DRC and hubs export, but China is the largest refiner/consumer.

740811.title: Copper wire, cross-section > 6 mm
740811.boundary: A semi-finished form electrification uses; not all copper wire.

740400.title: Copper waste and scrap
740400.boundary: The recycling stream; routes through hubs, and much scrap is used domestically.
